name: The Dark Side of the World
source:
In this bleak and merciless world, where darkness has swallowed everything alive, lives Rin — a heroine whose soul is shattered and scarred by the horrors she has endured. Her story is not just a tale of suffering but a cry of pain, tearing the heart of anyone brave enough to listen. You will learn how the thread of fate was torn apart, what led to this chaos and destruction, and what high price she had to pay for the only glimmer of hope.​

[From [url=https://deasfulf.itch.io/dark-world]Itch.io[/url]]
